text:
riley: Quick huddle — were rolling out a Community DevPack: hands-on tutorial repo + a "Bench & Build" webinar. Need: 1) launch blog post, 2) ultra-short benchmark narrative for the blog and webinar slide, 3) webinar page copy with 2 headline variants, 4) form -> HubSpot routing + UTMs. Who takes what?
sam: Ill take the launch post and the benchmark blurb. Will keep bench in plain language (p50/p95 + cost per 1k tokens) and add a 1-line dev takeaway for socials.
anya: I can handle HubSpot routing + UTMs and confirm test leads. Will add a simple role field and tag logic. Suggest utm_source=devpack and utm_campaign=bench_build_launch.
morgan: Ill write the webinar page copy and two headline options. Also will craft a one-line chart caption for the slide: something punchy like "p95 down 28% — cost per 1k tokens down 36%" (final numbers from Sam).
riley: Love it. Sam, make bench digestible for PMs too (one sentence). Morgan, give A/B headlines short, <10 words each. Anya, test lead screenshot before publish.
sam: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood/community-devpack/pull/256 — includes blog draft, bench table, and a 30-40 word dev-takeaway for Twitter. Bench quick summary: workload=chat completions, models compared=open quantized runner vs baseline; p50=120ms vs 180ms, p95=310ms vs 430ms, cost per 1k tokens=$0.45 vs $0.70. Plain takeaways in PR.
anya: Routing plan snippet: HubSpot form id=7712. UTMs: utm_source=devpack, utm_medium=web, utm_campaign=bench_build_launch. Tagging logic: ```
// role tag
if (form.role === "engineer") { tag = "eng" }
else if (form.role === "product") { tag = "pm" }
else { tag = "other" }
``` Ill also fire a lead score event if they check "deploying to prod" checkbox.
morgan: Headline A: "Build a low-latency chat app — live" Headline B: "Bench & Build: ship a production chat refapp" Leaning A for clarity. CTA: "Register to follow the code + live benchmarks."
riley: Two micro-asks: 1) Sam — paste a 35-word dev tweet in PR comments. 2) Anya — confirm pixel + HubSpot test lead before we schedule emails.
sam: Tweet draft added to PR comments: "Build a low-latency chat app in one session. We open-source the refapp, share configs, and show live benchmarks that cut p95 and cost on open models. Join the Bench & Build webinar: [link]"
anya: Pixel installed on staging page; test lead received in HubSpot (screenshot attached to PR). Mapping looks good.
lina-bot: Reminder — staging deploy queued for 2026-02-14T15:00:00Z.
riley: Timeline: aim to publish blog + open regs by Tue 09:00 UTC so we can run two reminder emails. Sam, finalize copy tonight. Morgan, pick primary headline and put alt in PR. Anya, confirm lead flows are tagged.
morgan: Primary headline locked to A. Alt in PR.
sam: Final edits pushed. Added a 1-sentence PM takeaway: "Smaller infra tweaks + model quantization delivered measurable UX wins while lowering inference cost."
anya: Verified test flows and role tags. Works end-to-end. Screenshots in PR.
riley: Great — set email schedule and drop calendar invite for the webinar rehearsal. Thanks team :rocket:
